notes: Recording: a Microsoft Teams recording of the board-room speaker-tracking camera (a close-up of the current speaker over a wide strip of the room); name plates are legible in the close-ups. TelVue had no broadcast copy (checked 2026-11-13).

Seen at the table, by name plate: Vital Anne (Board President), Emina Alic (Board Vice President), Matt Haupt; Dr. Machesky at the head. Audra Melton (black hoodie, seat beside Haupt) and Stephanie Zendler (gray cardigan, at the side table) are identified by voice against their settled 2026-10-06/10-20 voiceprints (Melton 0.84-0.98, Zendler 0.69-0.88 on camera-confirmed turns). No roll call was taken on the recording; Potts and Philippart are neither seen nor heard, which is not recorded as an absence.
A = Vital Anne: chairs and opens the meeting; plate VITAL ANNE / BOARD PRESIDENT beside her at 2:53:50; 'You're stuck with me for another 6 years' after re-election.

I = Emina Alic, NOT Matt Haupt as the identifier said: in every close-up during I's turns (1:17:05, 1:19:30, 2:09:30, 2:18:00, 2:20:40, 2:30:35, 2:34:20, 2:48:42, 2:56:27, 3:09:25, 3:11:58) the speaker is the woman at the EMINA ALIC plate while Haupt, at the MATT HAUPT plate beside her, listens. Content agrees: she went to Athens, has a middle schooler, joined the board two years before the 2024 trustees, and says 'Matt just says' (3:11:53). split_cluster.py seeded from five of those turns: 53 of 63 lines Alic, seed check 0.66 same vs 0.46 different.

C = Dan Trudel ('You want to hit those last 2 items, Dan?'), D = Dr. Machesky ('since I've been superintendent'), J = Christine DiPilato ('Christine had sent them out'; answers 'Christine, just to clarify').

Guests: F = Kyle Anderson, Finance Director (Trudel: 'I have Kyle Anderson, our Finance Director ... tag team'); E = Keith McDonald, Plante Moran Realpoint (self-introduction, STT 'Kimmie Daron with Plant Randall Point'; Trudel: 'that's why we have Keith here'); K = Sarah Smotherman, Director of Special Education (DiPilato: 'Sarah, get over to you'); B = Jamie Evans (Smotherman: 'Jamie talked a little bit about our categorical continuum expansion'); H = Hillary Pulliam (introduced as supervisor who 'also supports the preschool'; H presents early childhood -- by elimination among the three supervisors Smotherman introduced); L = Erica Conklin, supervisor of behavioral supports (self-description; the 2025-10-07 packet lists her as Behavior Support Coordinator).

Reassignments come from ECAPA voiceprints (cache Troy School Board Meeting - 2026-11-10.ecapa.json; centroids from each settled cluster's own 3-s+ lines) where the margin was clear AND the context agreed: e.g. 0:48:37/0:48:56 are Zendler's study questions (0.64/0.61), 2:36:56 'in lieu of sheltered classes' is Zendler (0.72; she adds 'I keep calling it the wrong word'), 2:29:48 'I as a parent' is Alic (0.57), 2:23:39 is Trudel finishing his own sentence (0.75). Left as diarized: 1:33:12 (G, Jamie 0.55 vs own 0.43, context ambiguous) and 2:28:47 (A; DiPilato's 'The other is' runs into Anne's question).

SECOND PASS (2026-11-13), after the owner reported attribution errors: cluster G was Zendler AND Melton merged (the third meeting in a row; 2026-09-01, 10-06). Every line was scored against one reference voice per person (prior-meeting settled voices blended with this meeting's camera-confirmed turns; script kept in this folder as reattrib.py) and classed KEEP 478 / MOVE 17 / UNSURE 100 / SHORT 280. MOVE lines were reassigned (14 to Melton). Confidence rule from the owner: a line is named only where voice and context agree; UNSURE lines resolved by context or set to 'Unidentified speaker'; every sub-1.5 s line diarized into G (80) and every Zendler/Melton near-tie (<0.08) is unidentified. Matt Haupt: present by name plate, but no line on the recording matches his voice (the 0:53:29 line the camera cut to him on scores 0.08 against his 10-20 voice), so none is attributed to him. 2:30:41 'We got our tests back' is unidentified (Anne/Alic tie; camera on Alic).

BACK-TEST (2026-11-13, transcription/backtest_voice.py, 4 settled meetings, leave-one-out): a line moved on voice alone needs >= 0.60 (99.3% precision, 1.4% of guest lines falsely named, with 2 seed turns per person). Three moves above were 0.51-0.57 and are now unidentified: 0:53:36, 1:33:12, 2:04:03.
